title: National Waterway 20 _Bhavani River:
text:
20. National Waterway 20 _Bhavani River:_

Bhavani Sagar Dam, Sathyamangalam at Lat 11[o]28‟16”N, Lon
77[o]06‟49”E to confluence of Bhavani and Kaveri rivers at Kaveri
river bridge on Salem-Coimbatore Highway: “National

Highway-47 Lat 11[o]25‟54”N, Lon 77[o]41‟02”E.
